decisive_items: A subcutaneous nodule of approximately 1 cm diameter was present under the hypogastrium.
Revealed endometrial glands consisting of a single layer of monomorphous cuboidal cells with an endometrial stroma
The mass was accompanied by slight pain that worsened around menstruation.
response.rationale: R1 is more specific and accurate, as the subcutaneous location, history of prior surgery, and cyclical pain support abdominal wall endometrioma. R2 is a broader term that is also correct but less precise.

rejected.why: Less specific; the diagnosis is better captured by the anatomically precise term abdominal wall endometrioma.
